✅ Correct Answer: A — Niki Lauda

📖 Explanation:

Niki Lauda finished second on track behind his McLaren teammate John Watson at Zolder, but was disqualified during post-race scrutineering when his car weighed 578 kg — 2 kg under the required limit.

The post-race decision promoted Eddie Cheever to second place for Ligier and Ferrari's Didier Pironi to third.

It was one of several major weight controversies during the infamous 1982 FISA–FOCA war.
